positioning: Nachtfiets is the end of buying bike lights: EUR 9 a month and you never ride dark again, even after a theft.
key_messages: The theft is the story, not the light

channels.role: Lead channel: theft stories from real waitlisters
Story posts with a place name and a hard CTA

two_week_plan.focus: Theft stories by location: Centraal, Zuidas, UvA, VU

success_metric: 300 waitlist signups by day 14, tracked from campaign page clicks
changes_from_previous_round: Mei found the number-led hooks saturating and LinkedIn bottom of the ranking two days running. LinkedIn is dropped, the hook family switches from numbers to first-person theft stories tied to Nora's parking hotspots, and Instagram posts must name a place.
message_to_team: Lena, round three: no numbers in headlines this time. Two first-person theft stories, each naming a place from Nora's hotspot list. X leads, Instagram follows, LinkedIn is out.
